thread.title: Everything we’re expecting Apple to announce at its biggest hardware event of the year (AAPL)

author: Avery Hartmans
title: Everything we’re expecting Apple to announce at its biggest hardware event of the year (AAPL)
text: Stephen Lam/Getty Apple's biggest hardware event of the year is only a few days away. If past years are any indication, the event will be used to unveil a slew of new products, including new iPhones, a new Apple Watch, and maybe even a refreshed pair of its wireless AirPods. Based on analysts, leaks, and reports, here's what we're expecting Apple to announce at its biggest hardware event of the year. 1 / Apple is expected to unveil new smartphones with super-high definition OLED screens, potentially named the iPhone Xs and iPhone Xs Max ... 9to5Mac According to KGI Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo , Apple is expected to release three new iPhones total, including two devices with OLED screens. The two OLED phones will come in different sizes — 6.5-inch and 5.8-inch — and will have the same nearly full-screen display and facial recognition camera as the iPhone X. Last month, Apple blog 9to5Mac published what it said was an actual marketing photo for two new iPhone devices. The images show two gold phones, which 9to5Mac says are called the iPhone XS and the iPhone XS Max.
